rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>What a crazy story. We've ended up somewhere far away, and right in front of us is a bunch of unknowns, huh.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Wh-what's going to happen to us?!
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Nothing starts until we actually make contact.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Being told to fight guys we know nothing about doesn't sit right with me.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>In the first place... can we even get back home?!
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, calm down.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Why did this have to happen...!
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Cool your head, kid! At times like this, the ones who panic are the first to get shot down.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>He's right. I understand feeling anxious, but... ...?!
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>This sensation... a Newtype...? No... it's a little different...
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Amuro<ce()>? Are you sensing something again?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>...Yeah. It's a strange sensation, unlike any before...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>You're anxious after all, aren't you, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>But <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, you survived that battle in this machine your first time aboard. You'll be fine in any situation.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...Thanks.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Unusually straightforward of you.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...Not really.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Captain, what do we do if the side we're covering turns on us, too?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I'm praying it doesn't come to that.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>In any case, this ship is full of elites. Add the <color(4)>YF-19<ce()> and your skill, and there's nothing to fear, right?
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)>Man, you sure know what to say. Now I'd be a liar if I didn't deliver.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Even I'm rattled by this situation...
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>Weren't you supposed to be the great <color(4)>Kaine<ce()>...? Wish you'd pull yourself together.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Your eyes are darting around too, <color(4)>Tapp<ce()>, you know? You're as bad as each other.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Pathetic, the lot of you... Get a grip!
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>You don't have to tell us! We're the invincible <color(4)>Dragonar team<ce()>!

uncertainties.issue: 'the side we're covering' - refers to the faction they are about to support in the mission; 'Captain' = Amuro (taii).
'Dragonar team' follows majority usage (7x) in existing translation files; not a locked glossary entry.

meaning_fixes.reason: 'sunao' here = Barrel accepting Faye's encouragement without his usual pushback; 'honest' wrongly implies he is normally untruthful. Translator flagged the same doubt.

checked_decisions: 1/59 'the side we're covering' / 'Captain' = Amuro (taii, and Amuro answers). Wording follows source 'engo suru hou mo teki ni mawattara'. Accepted; faction not verified.
1/103 'Dragonar team': corpus 9 vs 'Dragonar unit' 2, no glossary lock. Kept; name-script matter.
0/27 'He's right' - Isamu is male per glossary.
remaining_uncertainties: 1/59: which faction 'the side we're covering' is was not checked against the mission script.
1/22: replacement 'straightforward' is my reading of 'sunao' (open/not contrary); 'agreeable' would also be defensible.
